name: console-get-logs
description: Recent Unity Console entries. Filter severity with levels; use contains for message text search. Output counts: matched=raw entries matching the filters; groups=distinct entries after dedupe; count=entries actually returned (after maxEntries and size limits); dropped=groups omitted from that cap; each entry's repeats=how many duplicates collapsed into it. For freshness: capture lastEventId (returned here or from bridge-get-status), then re-run with sinceEventId to see only logs emitted after that cursor (e.g. a recompile or reimport).

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the message text. Caveat: an exact single word error/exception/warning/issue (or their plurals) is instead treated as a severity filter, not text search — use levels for severity, and add another word if you truly need to grep for that text.

sinceEventId.description: Only return logs with an event cursor greater than this. Use the lastEventId from a prior console-get-logs (or bridge-get-status) captured before a compile/reimport to distinguish fresh entries from stale ones. Matches only bridge-captured logs; Console/Editor.log rows without a cursor are excluded while this is set.

sinceTimestampUtc.description: Only return logs at or after this UTC timestamp (ISO 8601). Prefer sinceEventId for precise freshness; timestamps on Console/Editor.log rows reflect read time, not capture time.

dedupe.description: Collapse identical entries into one row with a repeats count. Default on. Set false to see every raw occurrence.
